title: Beemaar Ki Aankhein
body:
Beemar ki ankhein hai
(Ya hussain) x4
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai) x2 akbar teree raho par
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2 Deewarey bhee rotee hai sughra kee karaho par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sughra ney kaha mujko eik baar jo mil jaaey) x2 Sar apna mai rak-doongee bhaiya tere paa-o par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kyu bhool gaye bhaiya sughra kee khata kya hai) x2 Aawaaz nahi deitey kyew mairee sada-o par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Vo kud-hee samajley gee hai maara gaya bhayi) x2 Deikhengi nisha jis dam zainab tere baho par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Deika key lahoo mai hai dooba huwa sab kunba) x2 Kya khwaab ootar aya sughra kee niga-ho par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Pyasey rahey jab akbar barsee na gata ko-ee) x2 Afsos karey duniya ab aisee gata-o par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Hai dhoop mai jis din sey laash ali akbar ka) x2 Ma ashk girati hai har pair kee chawo par
<<MINI>>
(Beemar kee aakei hai akbar teree raho par) x2
